lines.zh: 四爪拍地，跑得像颗肉弹。
lines.en: Four paws slap the dirt; I run like a ball of muscle.

lines.zh: 我拱起肩背，沿树根疾跑。
lines.en: I hunch my shoulders and sprint along the roots.

lines.zh: 我抬起前爪，露出磨尖的指甲。
lines.en: I raise a forepaw and show my sharpened nails.

lines.zh: 这身肌肉，是一口一口练出来的。
lines.en: Every muscle here was trained bite by bite.

lines.zh: 它盯着你手中的坚果，眼神闪烁着渴望。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with desire at the nuts in your hand.

lines.zh: 你手中的食物引来了它的注意。
lines.en: Food in your hand catches its attention.

lines.zh: 它偷偷接近，试图夺走你的食物。
lines.en: It sneaks closer, eyeing your food.

lines.zh: 看到你喂食，它也想尝尝。
lines.en: Seeing you feed, it wants a taste.

lines.zh: 你手中的坚果是它的下一个目标。
lines.en: The nut in your hand is its next target.

lines.zh: 它渴望着你手中的饼干。
lines.en: It desires the cookies in your hand.

lines.zh: 它好奇地嗅着你带来的食物。
lines.en: It sniffs curiously at the food you bring.

lines.zh: 你的食物让它起了贪吃的念头。
它试图从你手中抢过食物。
lines.en: It tries to steal food from your hand.

lines.zh: 它期待地望着你手中的食物。
lines.en: It looks eagerly at the food in your hand

lines.zh: 它一头撞向你，肌肉紧绷。
lines.en: It collides with you, muscles tensed.

lines.zh: 你被它的肌肉撞击震得后退。
lines.en: You stagger back from its muscle撞击.

lines.zh: 它试图用身体撞开障碍。
lines.en: It uses its body to ram obstacles.

lines.zh: 它怒气冲冲地撞向岩石。
lines.en: It rams the rock in anger.

lines.zh: 它的肌肉撞向你，你感到一阵巨痛。
lines.en: Its muscles collide with you, causing intense pain.

lines.zh: 它的肌肉紧绷，准备撞向你。
lines.en: Its muscles tense, preparing to collide.

lines.zh: 它全力撞击，试图推开你。
lines.en: It collides full force, trying to push you away.

lines.zh: 它用身体撞开面前的障碍。
lines.en: It rams its way through obstacles.

lines.zh: 它的肌肉在撞击中紧绷如弓。
lines.en: Its muscles tense like a bow in collision.

lines.zh: 它寻找着伴侣，发出低沉的叫声。
lines.en: It searches for a mate, making a low call.

lines.zh: 它用叫声吸引着潜在的伴侣。
lines.en: It attracts a potential mate with its call.

lines.zh: 它呼唤着同类前来交配。
lines.en: It calls for a mate to come together.

lines.zh: 它用独特的叫声吸引伴侣。
lines.en: It calls with a unique sound to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 它发出求偶的叫声，声音低沉而有力。
lines.en: It makes a deep, powerful call for a mate.

lines.zh: 它的叫声在洞穴中回荡，寻求伴侣。
lines.en: Its call echoes in the cave, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 它在洞穴入口发出求偶的叫声。
lines.en: It makes a call for a mate at the cave entrance.

lines.zh: 它在夜晚发出求偶的低吼声。
lines.en: It lets out a low growl to call a mate at night.

lines.zh: 它的求偶叫声穿透黑暗。
lines.en: Its mating call pierces the darkness.

lines.zh: 它寻找着洞穴中可能的伴侣。
lines.en: It searches for a potential mate in the cave

lines.zh: 这身肌肉，是为你绷起来的。
lines.en: These muscles are tightening for you.

lines.zh: 我鼻子一抽，抓到你的味。
lines.en: One sniff and I have your scent.

lines.zh: 肌肉在皮毛下鼓起来了。
你这块头，够我拖回洞里。
lines.en: Your size will fit in my burrow.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕到身后，当弹簧。
lines.en: I coil my tail behind me like a spring.

lines.zh: 草丛那边的人影，我看到了。
lines.en: I see the figure beyond the grass.

lines.zh: 十五点血也够我咬穿你。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts are enough to bite through you.

lines.zh: 我数着你的步子，后腿在攒力。
lines.en: I count your steps while my hind legs gather force.
My hind legs cock like a drawn bow.

lines.zh: 我把爪子抠进泥里借力。
lines.en: I dig my claws into the mud for grip.

lines.zh: 你的脚踝是最软的地方。
lines.en: Your ankle is the softest part.

lines.zh: 我隔着一小段距离起跳。
lines.en: I leap from a short distance out.

lines.zh: 胡须扫过草叶，量你的位置。
lines.en: My whiskers brush the grass, measuring you.

lines.zh: 胸肌鼓胀，随时能弹出去。
lines.en: My chest swells, ready to fire me forward.
I wait for the moment you lift a foot.

lines.zh: 磨牙声停了，那是要咬了。
lines.en: My gnashing stops. That means I am about to bite.
I circle to your rear flank.
I have watched this meat for a while.
Claws leave the ground in an instant.
Grinding teeth, the Muscular Mouse is here!
Muscular Mouse gathers, one hit wins!
I hit your chest like a cannonball!
I bite down on your fingers!
I tip you over with one shoulder!
I throw my whole body into the back of your knee.
My teeth punch through your boot!
I land whole on your back!
A flex of muscle flips you over!
I will talk after this bite!
Hiding in grass, waiting for an opportunity!

lines.zh: 在岩石间徘徊，寻找目标！
lines.en: Wandering in rocks, searching for a target!

lines.zh: 于森林深处游荡，伺机而动！
lines.en: Wandering in forest depths, waiting for an opportunity!

lines.zh: 于洞穴中潜行，猎杀敌人！
于矿洞中出没，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Appearing in mines, searching for prey!

lines.zh: 于草地中穿梭，伺机而动！
lines.en: Traveling in grass, waiting for an opportunity!

lines.zh: 于沙地里游荡，潜行追踪！
lines.en: Wandering in sand, stalking in stealth!

lines.zh: 于平原上游荡，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Wandering in plains, searching for prey!

lines.zh: 于沼泽中潜行，伺机而动！
lines.en: Traveling in swamps, waiting for an opportunity!
The grass shakes and I pop out.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤出来，抖了抖毛。
lines.en: I squeeze from a rock crevice and shake my fur.
